alerts.title: Russia Extends Ban On Most Diesel Exports Through January
alerts.why: Extending the Russian diesel export ban through January restricts global supply, significantly tightening middle distillate balances and supporting ICE gasoil and HO prices.

itemsSent.title: VLCC rates rising again as focus shifts toward war escalation risk
